descriptive: user, 2026-11-19 in chat: run the proper top-activating-neuron baselines soon; featurization = base with weak activations pruned. No reuse/new verdict is given; every lean below is a description checked against its filed range.

settings.settings_source: pairs, counted, seeds, n_read, read_seed, n_max, held_share, profile_batch: E208's filed settings (experiments/rho_saved_items/results/predictions.json), so the windows and the reference path are E208's; bands: Goodfire, 'Neurons as an interpretable basis' (p97/3 their main band; p99/1 and p90/10 from their percentile-band ablations), the user's sweep (2026-11-19); pile_rows: 400 val rows of 512 tokens (204,800 tokens per neuron, about 6,000 above p97), cut from the cached artifacts/sets val file; pile_batch: memory only; alpha, chunk, order_seed: E214's filed values (experiments/kstar_levels/results/predictions.json), one order (the attribution order, E214's order 0) for time; gate_tol: E208's; s_tol: E214's; floor_factor and floor_min: the control's stop bar is max(floor_factor x the measured floor, floor_min), the floor being the largest per-part difference between E208's own code (commute.rho.profile) rerun on control_item and E208's saved scores, measured in stage 0 before the control reads

readings.s_u: per variable, 1 - mean over settings of (1 - cos^2(F's write, M's write)), both zero counting 1 and one zero counting 0 (E208, E214); a feature's write is its strong part times its output column, the site remainder's the weak parts summed through the output columns; 'read' = the read position of each window (main, user 2026-11-19 for E214), 'all' = every position in both runs (E208's main, the control's)
readings.K*: kstar.search at neuron_head with one remainder per MLP site, mean ablation, alpha 0.9, greedy by chunks of 256 in the attribution order
readings.R: mean s_u over K*; f = changed share of K*; site_remainder_share = remainders in K* / |K*|
readings.overlap: per window, Jaccard of the strong-neuron sets of M (its run) and F (its run) at the read position, all four MLP sites pooled (an empty union counts 1: neither network has a feature there); mean over the 512 windows

expected.W0: F = M on control_item's windows, at every band and at the width: no changed variable, every s_u = 1 within s_tol under both grades, gate 'all' and 'none' <= gate_tol (the featurization is exact), overlap = 1. R reads 'no change' (no K* is searched: D, where F departs from M, is empty), f = 0 and no remainder is changed. A miss stops the job.
expected.pile_strong_share: the share of base activations on the Pile rows that are features: 0.06, 0.02 and 0.20 for p97/3, p99/1 and p90/10, each within 0.005 (by construction; ties at exact zeros could move it, and it is reported)
expected.read_strong_share: the same share on the read windows at W0, reported only: the windows are 8 tokens, so it can differ from the Pile's
expected.control: at the width (every activation a feature): every site remainder's s = 1 and its write zero; per item, R over every part and R over E208's five circuits (mean over orders), grade 'all', equal E213's (worst_k 'all' and e208_K_mean under 'main', 0.9994-0.99995 on all 20 items) within max(floor_factor x floor, floor_min); a miss on any item stops the job before stage 1. The largest per-part difference from E208's saved scores is reported.
expected.gates: every item and band: gate 'all' <= gate_tol (F_K with every variable kept is F); a miss stops that task

P1.what: R_read on K* at the width
P1.lean: at or above 0.99 on all 20 trained fine-tunes (E213's saturation, now with K* by mean ablation)

P2.lean: between 0.95 and 0.999 on every trained fine-tune, and below the same item's R_read at the width: a threshold crossing between the two runs scores 0 at that setting

P3.lean: every K* holds all four site remainders (the weak activations carry part of every behaviour: E190's masking cost 0.89-5.76 nats), so the share is 4 / |K*|, under 0.01

P4.what: s of each site remainder at p97/3, grade read
P4.lean: at or above 0.99 on every item: the summed weak write turns little

P5.lean: between 0.7 and 0.99 on every trained fine-tune (1 at W0 and at the width)

P6.lean: at or above 0.99: every neuron and site of a full fine-tune is changed; only an unchanged embedding or unembedding in K* lowers it

P7.what: reuse-minus-twin gaps of R_read, counted pairs, each band
P7.lean: reported per seed with the seed difference beside it; no lean and no verdict (descriptive)

stops: stage 0: W0 miss, pile_strong_share outside its band by more than 0.02 (a broken percentile), or a control miss -> exit 1, no stage 1. Stage 1: a gate miss -> exit 1 for that task.
status: Filed 2026-11-19 before any run; never edited after a reading.
